text.en: The sitio of Matipunso, barrio of Niing in the Municipality of Tiaong, Province of Quezon, is hereby constituted into a new barrio in the said municipality to be known as the barrio of Matipunso.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1957.
